general_description.subject: Two young adult women in a surreal, crystal-clear underwater pool world, walking and laughing as sunlight filters through the surface. The sequence blends dreamlike grace with real physics — buoyancy, bubbles, cloth dynamics, and refraction.
general_description.tone: ethereal realism, gentle joy, and transcendence
general_description.style: cinematic photomanga, underwater dream aesthetic, true-physics simulation
general_description.environment: sunlit pool with perfect clarity, suspended microbubbles, turquoise gradient, slow drifting caustics, volumetric rays, and reflections under the surface
general_description.audio: ambient underwater hums, soft laughter filtered through water, distant ripples, bubble crackles, and faint surface shimmer

buoyancy.foot_contact: occasional; slight kick-up of silt and particulate lasting <2 s

cloth_dynamics.material: light cotton / chiffon blend, density 950–1050 kg/m³
cloth_dynamics.air_trap: initial positive buoyancy from air pockets; purge over 2–3 s
cloth_dynamics.hem_behavior: flares upward then settles; small vortex shedding

hair_dynamics.behavior: low Reynolds-number flutter, clumping and curling under motion

bubbles.detachment: from fabric edges, straps, and hands
bubbles.patterns: spiral microtrails forming around fingers and hem edges

optics.caustics: cell size 6–12 cm, sweep velocity 0.2–0.4 m/s
optics.dispersion: slight chromatic shift, enhanced blue-green bias with red attenuation
optics.surface_reflection: rippling mirror distortion with refracted self-images

particles_and_flow.vortices: toroidal eddies trailing limbs, dissipate in 1–2 s
particles_and_flow.streaklines: visible laminar flow trails illuminated by caustics

camera_physics.optical_effects: chromatic dispersion at surface, slight distortion at wide angles

sound_physics.sources: bubble crackle, body wake, distant surface ripple

scenes.description: Overhead view as the camera dives beneath the surface. Two young women descend slowly, dresses ballooning with trapped air and streams of bubbles. The sunlight fractures into beams.
scenes.camera: overhead crane, slow dolly dive into the pool
scenes.motion: gradual descent; fabrics lag with 300 ms delay; hands drift naturally downward
scenes.lighting: sunbeams penetrate the surface; volumetric rays through suspended particles

physics.optics: refraction and surface ripple distortion on faces

scenes.audio: soft hums, faint water entry sound, muted splash fading out

scenes.description: They touch the pool floor and begin to laugh, releasing tiny air streams. Their hair waves around their faces, creating delicate vortex lines.
scenes.camera: medium shot at waist level, slightly upward angle
scenes.motion: shoulders shake with laughter, bubbles and fabric rise gently
scenes.lighting: soft caustics sweep across their faces; warm highlights

physics.cloth: drag 1.4, hem lags 0.3 s behind movement
physics.bubbles: dense clusters escaping from mouths, rising 0.15–0.25 m/s
physics.flow: microvortices from motion fade within 2 s

scenes.audio: muted laughter filtered by water, bubble pops, ambient ripples

scenes.description: They walk gracefully along the pool floor, dresses flowing behind them like slow ribbons.
scenes.camera: side dolly following at equal pace
scenes.motion: hair and cloth flow backward, synchronized with laminar water movement
scenes.lighting: dynamic caustics on floor; turquoise tone gradient

physics.buoyancy: neutral, sand and particulate swirl beneath feet
physics.wake: turbulent vortex sheet trailing legs, dissipating in 1.5 s

scenes.audio: soft footsteps and laughter echo through the water

scenes.description: They look upward, seeing distorted mirror versions of themselves rippling on the surface.
scenes.camera: wide angle tilt up from below; reflections above
scenes.motion: gentle hand gestures sending ripple waves upward
scenes.lighting: specular reflections and light flares at surface

physics.refraction: Snell & Fresnel reflections merge; 5–8% mirror reflectance
physics.bubbles: micro trails floating to the top edge

scenes.audio: slow ambient swell, faint shimmer tone

scenes.description: A wide orbiting shot as caustic light lattices move rhythmically across their dresses and skin.
scenes.motion: graceful sway synchronized with caustic motion
scenes.lighting: moving grid of light (6–12 cm cells) sweeping 0.3 m/s

physics.fluid: transition from laminar to turbulent flow around ankles

scenes.audio: light pulsing tones synchronized with motion

scenes.description: Close-up of their hands and dress hems as air escapes in streams of bubbles curling upward.
scenes.camera: macro zoom, tracking bubbles rising past lens
scenes.motion: hands brushing against fabric; bubble spiral motion
scenes.lighting: bright caustic sparkles on bubbles; shallow depth of field

physics.cloth: micro vortex emission points at hem edge
physics.wake: faint swirls with visible particulate trails

scenes.description: They rise toward the surface, illuminated by golden sunlight. The camera tracks from below as the water turns to radiance.
scenes.camera: tracking upward shot, following ascent silhouettes
scenes.motion: floating dresses trail with halo effect; upward drift ~0.1 m/s
scenes.lighting: golden rim light and volumetric bloom; rainbow dispersion

physics.optics: chromatic dispersion; prism effect on edges

scenes.audio: crescendo of light tones, fading to silence at surface

physics_notes_to_bake.buoyancy: Near-neutral; slow sink rate ≈ 0.07 m/s; subtle lift during stride.
physics_notes_to_bake.cloth_dynamics: Chiffon fabric Cd≈1.4; 200–400 ms lag; trapped air release over 2–3 s.
physics_notes_to_bake.hair_motion: Clumped flutter; curl memory; slow drift alignment with eddies.
physics_notes_to_bake.bubble_behavior: 0.5–5 mm; rise 0.15–0.30 m/s; spiral detachment from fabric.
physics_notes_to_bake.optics: IOR water 1.333; Snell & Fresnel reflection; caustic cell 8 cm moving 0.3 m/s; dispersion at edges.
physics_notes_to_bake.lighting_physics: Volumetric caustics (20° cone spread); attenuation gradient 6000–8500K; visible particle scattering.
physics_notes_to_bake.flow_field: Micro-vortices shed from limbs dissipate within 1.5 s; boundary layer clings to fabric before breakup.
physics_notes_to_bake.camera_physics: 26 mm lens; f/4.5; shutter 1/400 s; 8500K white balance; ISO 800; dome housing refraction distortion.

drop_in_physics_realism_block.fluid: chlorinated clear water with low turbidity
drop_in_physics_realism_block.bubble_rise: 0.2 m/s; detached from hands and hems
